**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

Section 19 of the MSA satisfies the preferred WARRANTY position on every material term:

- **Services standard** (19.1): professional and workmanlike, qualified personnel, industry standards, plus conformance to documentation and specifications — reinforced by § 3.1.
- **Duration** (19.2): 90 days for Deliverables, measured from the **later** of delivery or acceptance; Hosted Services conform **throughout the subscription term** (better than a fixed software period).
- **Additional warranties** (19.3): no intentionally introduced malicious code, compliance with Applicable Law, no functionality diminishment, no contaminating open source.
- **Remedy** (19.4): re-perform / repair / replace at no charge, escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid; expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims.
- **Disclaimer** (19.5): mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly states that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy — so it does not swallow the express warranty.

I also checked the two risks flagged in the planner note: § 6 acceptance testing does not truncate the warranty period (the 90 days runs from the later of delivery or acceptance, and § 6.2 adds an independent correction/refund path), and § 3 only strengthens the performance standard. Nothing to redline here.
